```python

result = call_tool("restart_container", container_id="nginx-exit-test")
```

Tool: restart_container

The container nginx-exit-test has been successfully restarted, but it still shows as exited. Since the issue persists even after the restart, it indicates that the problem is not resolved by a simple restart. 

I recommend escalating this issue to further investigate the root cause of the database connection failure.
